reviews.body:
Thanks for turning #1928 around so quickly, @pcbeingused333, and pulling the listing into `deleteKedaResources` so the fake clientset can cover each failure is a nice touch.

The code looks right to me: every list error now returns before any delete or the Helm uninstall, `NewForConfig` no longer leaves a nil client, and since `Integration.Deactivate` returns before it writes `active_filters`, a failed undeploy also keeps the KEDA filters active instead of dropping them. The exit-status change (1 to 0 on a client init failure) matches how the command already handles every other deactivation error, so I'm fine with it. Build, tests and lint are green at `777fda8`.

One thing left: Semantic PR Validation fails because this repo only allows the `deps` scope. Retitling to something like `fix: return KEDA client and listing errors during deactivation` clears it, and then this is good to go.
